### Tables


::: {#tbl-summary .cell tbl-cap='Summary Statistics'}

```{.r .cell-code}
data_1 %>% 
  summarise(
    Mean_Age = mean(Age),
    SD_Age = sd(Age),
    Mean_SBP = mean(SysBP_0m),
    SD_SBP = sd(SysBP_0m)
  ) %>% 
  knitr::kable()
```
